title: Automated Core Laboratory, Ft. Benning Ga
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY MEDICAL COMMAND.US ARMY HEALTH CONTRACTING ACTIVITY.W40M MRC0 WEST
description_text: PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE: THE GOVERNMENT INTENDS TO AWARD A FIRM FIXED PRICE CONTRACT FOR: Fully Automated Core Laboratory System, Cost-Per-Reportable Results (CPRR) for automation clinical chemistry and immunodiagnostic testing systems for Martin Army Community Hospital (MACH), Fort Benning Georgia 31905 SOLICITATION WILL BE POSTED ON OR ABOUT 8 MAY 2026. ALL requirements in the solicitation and Statement of Work MUST BE MET for vendor consideration.
